chunks: “Wash your heads with sidr leaves, for every angel brought near and every sent prophet has sanctified it. Whoever washes his head with sidr leaves, Allah will turn away from him the whispering of Shaytan for seventy days. And whoever Allah turns away from the whispering of Shaytan for seventy days will not disobey Allah, and whoever does not disobey Allah will enter Paradise.”

key_terms.السِّدْرِ: sidr, the lote tree leaves used here for washing
key_terms.مَلَكٍ مُقَرَّبٍ: an angel brought near to Allah
key_terms.وَسْوَسَةَ الشَّيْطَانِ: the whispering and insinuation of Shaytan

ai.seo_question: What are the virtues of washing the head with sidr leaves in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages washing the head with sidr leaves and presents it as a blessed practice honored by the angels and prophets. It links this act with protection from the whisperings of Shaytan, leading to obedience to Allah and ultimately entry into Paradise.
